minutes.headline: ZBA granted a rear-yard deck permit, then continued the Weyland 40B apartment hearing to August 27 with waivers unresolved.
minutes.summary: The board granted a special permit for a rear-deck dimensional variation at 5 Crocker Avenue and extended a teardown/rebuild permit for 178 Peninsula Drive. Most of the evening continued the Weyland Luxury Apartments 40B hearing: sewer fees, peer review, traffic, water line size, land for the water district, and a long waiver list. Several waivers were tabled and the hearing was continued. A stretch of the recording is unrelated radio fundraiser audio.

what_happened.line: The board continued the Weyland Luxury Apartments 40B hearing 60 days to August 27 at 7 pm, with several waivers tabled; the vote was not audible.
The board worked through the applicant's waiver list and tabled several waivers without settling them.
The applicant argued current sewer fees make the project unaffordable and was told to meet the sewer department and return with a specific waiver request.
The board granted a special permit for a seven-foot rear-yard setback variation for a deck at 5 Crocker Avenue; no one was opposed.
The board extended the special permit for the 178 Peninsula Drive teardown and rebuild.

why_it_matters: Sewer fee waivers on the Weyland 40B project decide how much of the cost of connecting to town sewer the developer pays and how much is left to the town's sewer system.
The 40B process lets the board waive local rules, so the waiver list, traffic review and water district land questions shape what is built next to existing neighborhoods.
